title: Sample count per Fourier coefficient
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the exact-degree sample count per coefficient is the Fourier estimator sample count at the degree-$k$ coefficient accuracy, using the finite-family coefficient confidence for the low-degree Fourier family on $n$ coordinates and its stated nonemptiness witness.
caveat: The definitions of the accuracy, estimator sample count, confidence, and low-degree Fourier family are not included, so the construction cannot be rendered more explicitly.
